$comment: Starting point for <policy_dir>/claude/settings.json. It is intentionally workspace-relative so one access profile can be reused for several project workspaces. chmod 600 and keep it outside every workspace. Adapt and test with the installed Claude Code version; Enso checks launch plumbing, not policy meaning.
$comment_write_boundary: This conservative read-only starting point disables shell, write, notebook-edit, and web tools. It also denies parent-relative reads and sensitive Enso paths. If clients need more, add the smallest native grants supported by your installed CLI while keeping AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude, .agents, and skills protected.
